# Errors

The stable taxonomy of spec §43. Codes never change meaning, so a script may match on them; the `name` is the selector `try`/`catch` and predicates over error values use.

| code | selector | kind | meaning | what to do |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Ono-Sendai-E0001` | `parse.syntax` | parse | The input is not valid Ono syntax. | Read the span the diagnostic points at; the construct there cannot become valid however much more you type. `help language` lists the syntax of every statement form. |
| `Ono-Sendai-E0002` | `parse.incomplete` | parse | The input ended in the middle of a construct; more text would complete it. | Close the open string, bracket or block. Interactively the editor keeps the line open; in a script the file ended early. |
| `Ono-Sendai-E0101` | `resolve.command_not_found` | resolution | No keyword, function, native command or executable answers to this name. | Check the suggestions the error carries, or run `help` to browse commands. `explain <name>` reports every resolution step that was tried (ADR-0011). |
| `Ono-Sendai-E0102` | `resolve.target_not_found` | resolution | The verb is known but has no such target. | Run `help <verb>` to list the targets that verb accepts, or `get command` to browse the registry. |
| `Ono-Sendai-E0103` | `resolve.ambiguous` | resolution | The name matches more than one candidate and no namespace was given. | Qualify the name with the namespace of the candidate you meant, for example `ono:get` or `dev.example.tool:scan`. The error lists every candidate's qualified name. |
| `Ono-Sendai-E0201` | `type.mismatch` | type | A value did not have the type the operation requires. | `type <expression>` shows what the value actually is. Convert it explicitly rather than relying on coercion. |
| `Ono-Sendai-E0202` | `type.unknown_field` | type | A record schema has no such field. | `type` on the stream shows the schema and its fields. A field that exists but is unknown to the provider is `null`, not a missing field (spec §10.5). |
| `Ono-Sendai-E0203` | `type.invalid_unit` | type | A unit was unknown, or two incompatible dimensions were compared. | Compare like with like: byte sizes with byte sizes, durations with durations. The unit suffix must be adjacent to the number, as in `512MiB`, not `512 MiB`. |
| `Ono-Sendai-E0301` | `io.not_found` | io | The path or resource does not exist. | Check the path; `get file <parent>` lists what is actually there. |
| `Ono-Sendai-E0302` | `io.permission_denied` | permission | The operating system refused access to the resource. | The current user lacks the required permission. Elevate explicitly rather than re-running blind; `explain` reports the privilege a command needs before it runs. |
| `Ono-Sendai-E0303` | `io.already_exists` | io | The resource already exists and would have been overwritten. | Choose another destination, or pass the command's explicit overwrite option. |
| `Ono-Sendai-E0304` | `io.not_directory` | io | A path component is not a directory. | One of the leading components of the path is a file; check the path spelling. |
| `Ono-Sendai-E0401` | `provider.unavailable` | provider | The provider cannot answer on this system right now. | The backing system is absent or not running — no systemd on this host, no container runtime socket. `get command <name>` names the provider a command needs. |
| `Ono-Sendai-E0402` | `provider.unsupported` | provider | The provider does not implement this capability. | Another provider for the same target may support it. The capability matrix generated from `docs/spec/capabilities.yaml` lists which provider answers what. |
| `Ono-Sendai-E0403` | `provider.schema_violation` | provider | A provider emitted a value outside the schema it advertises. | This is a defect in the provider, not in your pipeline. Report it with the output of `inspect` on the offending value. |
| `Ono-Sendai-E0501` | `external.exit_nonzero` | external | An external process exited with a non-zero status. | The status is carried in the error metadata. Use `||` to branch on it, or `try`/`catch` to handle it as a value. |
| `Ono-Sendai-E0502` | `external.signal` | external | An external process was terminated by a signal. | The signal name is carried in the error metadata. A signalled process did not choose its exit status, so treat it differently from a non-zero exit. |
| `Ono-Sendai-E0601` | `remote.unreachable` | provider | The remote link could not be established or was lost. | `test host <name>` probes reachability and reports where the attempt failed. An established link that dropped mid-pipeline reports the values it had already delivered. |
| `Ono-Sendai-E0602` | `remote.protocol_mismatch` | provider | The remote peer speaks an incompatible protocol version. | Upgrade the agent on the remote host, or connect in agentless mode where the local side does the work. |
| `Ono-Sendai-E0603` | `remote.host_key_changed` | safety | The remote host presented a different key than the one recorded for it. | Do not override this because it is inconvenient. Verify the new key out of band, then record it deliberately. A changed key is indistinguishable from an interception. |
| `Ono-Sendai-E0701` | `safety.confirmation_required` | safety | The operation needs explicit confirmation that this context cannot ask for. | Scripts and non-interactive sessions never wait for a TTY (spec §17.4). Re-run interactively, or pass the command's explicit confirmation option. |
| `Ono-Sendai-E0702` | `safety.policy_denied` | safety | A configured safety policy forbids the operation. | `get config safety.*` shows the policy and the layer that set it. Config mode denies external execution, network access and plugin load by design (ADR-0010). |
| `Ono-Sendai-E0801` | `stream.unbounded_operation` | stream | The operation requires bounded input but the stream is unbounded. | `sort`, `group`, `count` and `measure` need a finite input. Bound the stream first with `take <n>` or a window. |
| `Ono-Sendai-E0802` | `stream.cancelled` | cancelled | The stream was cancelled before it completed. | Cancellation propagates through native pipelines and becomes a signal for external processes (spec §18.5). Values already delivered remain valid. |
| `Ono-Sendai-E0803` | `stream.backpressure_timeout` | timeout | A consumer did not accept values within the configured budget. | The slow stage is named in the error metadata. Raise the budget, or insert a bounded stage such as `take` ahead of the consumer. |
